scheme_name: Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of 25 R.I.R./Kadaknath & 1000 Broiler Bird’s Unit and Stipend for Poultry Farming Training for Scheduled Tribes People of the State
other_conditions: Must have completed 6 days of poultry rearing training for the 25 R.I.R./Kadaknath bird unit and stipend scheme
Must have completed any poultry rearing training for the 1000 broiler birds unit scheme
Priority is given to female applicants
Priority is given to Below Poverty Line (BPL) applicants
benefits_summary: Provides up to 75% subsidy (maximum ₹6,000) for a 25 R.I.R./Kadaknath unit, up to 90% subsidy (maximum ₹8,15,000) for a 1000 broiler bird unit, and a training stipend of up to ₹2,000, each available to one family member.
